hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that creates multi-curve liquidity positions on pool initialization. On every swap, collects LP fees from all positions, swaps them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards. Applies a time-decaying dynamic launch fee (99% to 1% over 10 seconds) and fills Zora limit orders when ticks cross.
